other details: A Legacy of Evolution and Strong Corporate Foundation Established in 1976 as the "Anhui Branch of China Grain and Food Import and Export Corporation," our company, now known as AHCOF NEOCHAINS HOLDINGS CO., LTD., has undergone a significant evolution. Through strategic restructuring and ownership transformations, most notably becoming a member enterprise of Hailuo Group in 2018, we have built a robust foundation. With a registered capital of RMB 1 billion, the company reported a revenue of RMB 35 billion, total assets of RMB 26.8 billion, and an import-export volume of USD 2.246 billion in 2020. Our scale and performance are underscored by our ranking of 198th on the 2020 China Service Industry 500 list. Diversified Operations with Core Business Strength The company operates across four main sectors: trade, construction, real estate, and financial investment, with trade and construction serving as the dual core pillars of our business. This diversified yet focused portfolio is supported by a network of 80 subordinate enterprises and a workforce of over 3,200 employees, enabling comprehensive and integrated service capabilities. Leadership in International Trade and Global Partnerships Originating and excelling in international trade, the company has maintained the top position in import-export customs declaration volume among Anhui's foreign trade enterprises for many consecutive years. Our traditional strength lies in the import and export of agricultural products, particularly grains and foods. We have achieved an annual import-export volume exceeding USD 100 million for key commodities such as edible oils, sesame, frozen meat and poultry, and copper concentrates. Through subsidiaries like Anhui Anlong International Development Co., Ltd., we have cultivated strong partnerships with global industry leaders, including ADM, Bunge, Louis Dreyfus, and major domestic corporations. Integrated Industrial Chain and Brand Excellence Leveraging our international trade expertise, we have developed an integrated industrial chain, establishing eight food-processing enterprises in key locations like Hefei and Wuhu. This vertical integration focuses on the production and processing of agricultural products. Our commitment to quality is embodied in our flagship brands, "Tiantiwo" and "Ankefu," which are renowned both domestically and internationally for their "green, healthy, and safe" standards. This end-to-end control, from sourcing to finished products, ensures superior quality and stable supply, solidifying our market leadership.

other details: Established in 2009 Anhui Seeker Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. was established in 2009 and is headquartered in Bengbu City, Anhui Province, China. As a high-tech enterprise, the company specializes in the R&D, manufacturing, and software development of NAS and data communication products. The company owns proprietary operating systems and hardware solutions with full intellectual property rights. Our Core Business The company focuses on the independent R&D, production, and sales of NAS devices, switches, and other data communication products, coupled with software development and network system integration services. Under its flagship brand XikeStor, the company offers a wide range of NAS and networking products widely applied in enterprise data storage, home data centers, and security surveillance systems. Our Products & Technology The company has independently developed the Seeker Storage System, a Linux-based network operating system, and offers a diverse NAS product lineup including 2-bay, 4-bay, and 12-bay models. In 2026, the company launched the next-generation full-flash NAS, an AI NAS powered by the Intel Core Ultra 7 processor 255H, featuring 6 M.2 slots and 2 10GbE ports, with Oculink interface expansion for external GPU or high-speed device connectivity, an ideal platform for edge AI computing. Core Strengths The company is a strategic partner to globally renowned semiconductor manufacturers, including Intel, Western Digital, Realtek, Broadcom, Marvell, AMD, and MaxLinear. The company employs a technical and sales team of nearly 100 professionals, with over 95% holding bachelor's degrees or above. With subsidiaries in Shanghai, Hefei, Bengbu, and Shenzhen, the company operates over 5,000 square meters of office and production space. Furthermore, the company has jointly established "NAS R&D Centers" with five universities, including Huaibei Normal University and Fuyang University, focusing on storage hardware and software research and talent development. Global Market The company has been recognized as a National High-Tech Enterprise and an Anhui Provincial Big Data Enterprise. Its business covers more than 60 countries and regions worldwide, with customers spanning key markets such as North America, Japan, the EU, and beyond. The company maintains a mature global business network and operates sales channels on multiple e-commerce platforms. Be Our Partner Now Anhui Seeker Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. remains dedicated to continuous innovation and operational excellence, providing high-quality storage and networking solutions to customers worldwide.

company background: BLAKSTONE CO.,LTD Country/Region: South Korea Business Type: Manufacturer
other details: Specialized in IoT-Based Low-Power Road Environment Systems BLACKSTONE Co., Ltd is a climate technology company specializing in IoT-based low-power road environment systems and smart city infrastructure solutions. The company has developed a patented IoT low-power road water spray system that reduces dust resuspension and mitigates urban heat island effects. Smart Control & Monitoring Smart IoT Clean Cooling System measures real-time road conditions and automatically controls water spraying based on temperature and environmental data. It supports remote monitoring and control via smartphone apps and web platforms using a proprietary server system developed with JAVA and HTML5. Modular & Durable Design The system features a modular block assembly design that enables installation without road excavation, reducing construction time and cost. It is highly durable, easy to maintain, and designed to withstand heavy traffic and seasonal conditions. It also supports snow melting and de-icing in winter. Strong R&D Capabilities BLACKSTONE has strong R&D capabilities in IoT, sensor integration, and environmental monitoring. The system supports multiple sensors, including road surface temperature, fine dust, sulfur oxides, nitrogen oxides, VOCs, temperature, and humidity. Power Options & Advanced Control The company offers both conventional power and solar-powered models to adapt to various site conditions. It also applies a high-density PCB-based control system instead of a conventional PLC, improving efficiency and scalability.

company background: Blucalm Technology (Shenzhen) Co,. Ltd. ODM OEM Country/Region: China Business Type: Manufacturer
other details: About Blucalm Blucalm Technology is an audio technology company focused on PC-centered sound experiences. With operations in Shenzhen, Shanghai and Xiamen, we combine audio R&D, product development, manufacturing resources and global market experience to create innovative products for gaming, professional communication and everyday PC audio use. Our mission is "Better Communication, Better Collaboration." Gaming Audio Products Our gaming portfolio includes wired gaming headsets, USB gaming headsets and desktop gaming audio controllers. We focus on the real needs of PC gamers, including clearer footsteps, more intelligible team communication, convenient game and chat balance, microphone control and fast access to sound-enhancement functions. Our desktop controllers add dedicated physical audio control between the PC and headset, helping users manage sound without repeatedly leaving the game or navigating complicated software menus. DSP & PC Audio Expertise Our core team brings more than 20 years of experience in DSP audio technology, acoustic processing and device compatibility. We develop dedicated audio hardware and algorithms for voice clarity, environmental noise reduction, sound tuning, hearing protection and intuitive PC audio interaction. By combining local DSP processing with physical controls, we help brands build differentiated audio products that offer practical user benefits rather than only competing on appearance and basic specifications. Original Product Development Blucalm develops patented product concepts, private models and differentiated interaction solutions. Our capabilities cover desktop audio controllers, touchscreen-enabled audio bases, customizable charging stands, wired and wireless headsets, USB audio controllers and related PC audio accessories. We pay close attention to industrial design, ergonomics, acoustic performance, software interaction and product reliability throughout the development process. OEM & ODM Customization We provide OEM and ODM services for global brands, distributors and channel partners. Customization options include industrial design, structural design, acoustic tuning, DSP functions, button definitions, USB functions, software compatibility, user-interface development, colors, surface finishes, packaging and branding. We can also support specialized requirements such as localized softphone compatibility, customized call-control functions and product solutions for different markets and sales channels. Engineering to Mass Production Our team supports customers throughout the complete product-development process, from product definition, design and engineering to prototyping, tooling, testing and mass production. We work closely with customers to balance product performance, target pricing, reliability and production feasibility. Blucalm welcomes gaming brands, PC accessory brands, audio distributors and OEM/ODM partners looking for distinctive gaming headsets, gaming audio controllers and professional communication products.

other details: A Leader in Power Solutions Since 2010 Established in 2010, Boluo Xurong Electronics is a recognized national high-tech enterprise with over 15 years of dedicated expertise in the power supply industry. We integrate innovative R&D, intelligent manufacturing, and global sales operations to provide high-performance, reliable power solutions for a worldwide clientele. Our modern 8,000-square-meter factory in Huizhou, Guangdong Province, boasts an annual production capacity of over 2 million units, forming a robust foundation for meeting large-scale international demands. Comprehensive Product Portfolio for Diverse Applications Our extensive product range is engineered to meet the needs of various sectors. We specialize in computer power supplies (including PC, SFX, and FLEX series) and robust industrial power systems (such as redundant, server, and fully customized non-standard power supplies). The power output of our products spans a wide spectrum from 200W to 10,000W, effectively catering to diverse application scenarios in consumer electronics, data centers, and industrial automation. Core Technological Innovations and Customization At the heart of our products lies a commitment to technological advancement. Our proprietary innovations include independently developed intelligent temperature control technology, achieving Titanium-level conversion efficiency of 96%+, and patented circuit designs. We employ a modular architecture that facilitates rapid customization, allowing us to adapt quickly to specific client requirements. All our power supplies are equipped with comprehensive protection features, including OVP (Over Voltage Protection), SCP (Short Circuit Protection), UVP (Under Voltage Protection), and OPP (Over Power Protection). Uncompromising Quality and Global Compliance We implement a rigorous, four-dimensional quality control system that exceeds industry standards. This process encompasses material-level inspection using Japanese industrial-grade components, stringent in-line process control with AOI and ICT testing, extreme environmental testing, and thorough reliability verification in our own EMC lab. Our quality management is certified to ISO 9001:2015, and our products carry major global certifications, including CE, FCC, CB, CCC, TUV, and 80PLUS Bronze to Platinum energy efficiency ratings, ensuring seamless market access worldwide. Proven Global Partnership and Service Xurong Electronics has established a strong international presence, exporting to 56 countries and regions. We are committed to superior service, offering 24-hour rapid response support, which has contributed to a customer satisfaction rate consistently above 98% for five consecutive years. We sincerely invite global distributors and partners to visit our facility to explore opportunities for collaboration and jointly pioneer the next era of power supply technology.

other details: Specialized in Automotive Electronic Products Since 2020 Established in 2020, Changzhou Yuyang Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in automotive electronic products, serving a diverse clientele that includes 4S stores, automotive aftermarket channels, and vehicle manufacturers. We are committed to delivering high-quality solutions that enhance vehicle performance, protection, and aesthetics. Invisible Armor for Your Vehicle Our Car Paint Protection Film, commonly referred to as Clear Bra, is engineered to preserve a vehicle's original paint in flawless condition. It provides comprehensive, long-term protection against environmental and physical damage while maintaining the car's factory appearance and finish. Superior Material & Clarity Crafted from premium thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU), our film offers outstanding optical clarity, crystal clear, and free of haze. Once applied, it becomes virtually invisible, allowing the vehicle's true color and gloss to shine through. The material provides a durable yet discreet protective barrier that does not compromise aesthetics. All-Round Protection The film delivers robust defense against daily hazards such as scratches, stone chips, bug splatters, bird droppings, tree sap, and UV exposure. It effectively prevents paint oxidation, fading, and corrosion caused by harsh weather or environmental factors, helping vehicles maintain a like-new appearance for years. Self-Healing & Easy Maintenance Equipped with advanced self-healing technology, minor surface scratches and swirl marks disappear with exposure to sunlight or gentle heat, eliminating the need for additional maintenance. The stain-resistant surface is easy to clean. Simple Application & Removal Designed for straightforward installation, the film features a pressure-sensitive adhesive that ensures a smooth, bubble-free fit on all vehicle contours. It can be applied to high-impact areas such as the front bumper, hood, fenders, mirrors, and door edges. When removal is required, the film peels off cleanly without leaving residue or damaging the underlying paint. Ideal for Every Vehicle Whether protecting a brand-new car or revitalizing the appearance of an older model, our Car Paint Protection Film offers the ideal combination of durability, clarity, and low maintenance. It provides lasting peace of mind, keeping vehicles looking pristine in all driving conditions.

company background: Citic Heavy Industries Co., Ltd. Overseas Manufacturing Base Country/Region: China Business Type: Manufacturer
other details: Over 70 Years of History Founded in 1956, CITIC HIC is a domestically listed A-share company under CITIC Group. After 70 years of development, CITIC HIC has grown into an innovative and high-tech enterprise. As a key player in China's heavy equipment sector, it is a globally competitive supplier and service provider for heavy-duty mining equipment and complete cement plant equipment. It is also a leading R&D and industrialization base for special robots. Its market footprint covers 78 countries and regions, achieving an international layout across the entire process of R&D, manufacturing, marketing, and services. Adhering to its positioning in advanced equipment manufacturing, the company operates under a "Core Manufacturing + Integrated Services" business model, striving to become a world-class enterprise in advanced equipment manufacturing with global competitiveness. Business Scope The company is primarily engaged in the research and development, manufacturing, and sales of large-scale equipment, large-scale complete sets of technical equipment, and key foundational components in the fields of mining and heavy-duty equipment (including EPC projects), robotics and intelligent equipment, new energy equipment, and special-purpose materials. It also provides related supporting services and integrated solutions. Core Products Our core products include large-scale mining mills, crushers, high-pressure grinding rolls (HPGRs), vertical stirred mills, mine hoists, rotary kilns, large heavy-duty key castings and forgings, as well as offshore wind power equipment including monopiles, tower sections, jackets, hydraulic pile hammers, rock-socketed pile drills, low-wind-speed vertical-axis wind turbines, steam turbines, generators, specialized robots, intelligent coal mines, smart mines, among others. Innovation Driven CITIC HIC possesses two nationally recognized enterprise technology centers, as well as the State Key Laboratory of Intelligent Mining Heavy Equipment, a National Industrial Design Center, and the National Mining New Equipment and Material Safety Analysis and Verification Center. Its R&D achievements are remarkable, with 1,123 valid patents, including 585 valid invention patents. The company has led or participated in the formulation of 134 national standards and has completed over 400 major national and provincial/ministerial level key research projects. Specialized Robotics Business In the field of robotics, the Company focuses on the specialized robotics industry for special working conditions and hazardous environments. It has established itself among the top tier of China's specialized robotics sector. Centered around its "Intelligent Explosion-Proof Robot" - a product recognized as a National Manufacturing Champion Product - the Company has built a comprehensive "robot squad" product matrix covering multiple scenarios, including emergency rescue, mining operations inspection. Through the deep integration of "technology + scenarios," the Company leverages technological innovation to overcome the operational limitations of special environments where humans cannot approach, cannot reach, and cannot perform tasks. CITIC Heavy Industries now offers over 70 models of specialized robots, covering a wide range of fields such as coal mining, petrochemicals, and emergency rescue. Its products have been exported to countries across Europe, Southeast Asia, and other regions.

other details: About Us Coding I Do is an EdTech company that develops and provides STEAM education content and digital AI-based educational products for preschool and elementary school students. Our R&D and Global Expansion OBM and ODM services are available. Developed by our in-house R&D team since 2017, our products are widely utilized across educational institutions in Korea, and we are currently looking to expand into global markets.

other details: Factory Overview Dongguan Chuangyao Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. It is a high-tech enterprise integrating production, manufacturing, and sales. The company focuses on the research and development of PCBA solutions, customized development of wireless charging device receivers and transmitters, as well as the production of wireless watch charging devices. Personnel Structure The company has eight major departments, namely the Administration Department, Finance Department, Sales Department, Procurement Department, R&D Department, PMC (Production and Material Control Department), Production Department, and Quality Department, with a total of over 300 employees. Strong R&D Capabilities The company boasts a strong and professional design team with more than 20 members, including software engineers, hardware engineers, and structural engineers. Team members have over 10 years of rich experience in wireless charging design and production. Moreover, the company attaches great importance to R&D investment. Since its establishment, the proportion of R&D expenses in operating revenue has been increasing year by year and has now reached 17%. Up to now, the company has independently developed more than 40 PCBA solutions, which have been gradually put into production and sales, receiving positive market feedback. High Production Capacity The company has a 4,000-square-meter SMT (Surface Mount Technology) dust-free workshop equipped with 4 SMT production lines. It adopts a full set of advanced Yamaha production equipment, including automatic board conveyors, solder paste printers, high-speed chip mounters, high-temperature reflow soldering machines, AOI optical automatic inspection machines, etc. The daily delivery volume of PCBA (Printed Circuit Board Assembly) modules exceeds 40,000 pieces. In addition, the DIP (Through-Hole Soldering) workshop has 3 production lines with more than 60 skilled workers. The assembly line of the factory is staffed with more than 20 skilled technicians, with a daily production capacity of 3,000 to 5,000 pieces. Meanwhile, the factory is also equipped with screw machines, dispensing machines, air compressors, aging cabinets, as well as high and low temperature testers to improve production efficiency and ensure product quality. Quality Inspection Measures The company has established a professional Quality Department, covering IQC (Incoming Quality Control), IPQC (In-Process Quality Control), FQC (Final Quality Control), and OQC (Outgoing Quality Control), which conducts strict inspections on incoming materials, semi-finished products, and finished products. In addition, the QE (Quality Engineer) is responsible for formulating inspection standards (SIP) and quality improvement plans, leading customer complaint analysis (8D reports), SPC (Statistical Process Control) data monitoring, and promoting quality management processes such as APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) and PPAP (Production Part Approval Process). Quality Certifications The company has passed the ISO 9001:2015 quality management system certification and has independently developed a dedicated EPR (Material/Process Management) system. The products produced by the company have passed certifications such as CE and FCC and comply with the RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances) standard.

other details: Introduction Founded in 2005, JACC Office Machine Co., Ltd. JACC operates as the global-facing brand for marketing, product development, and OEM/ODM cooperation, while Dongguan Jiaxi serves as the registered manufacturing entity responsible for production, certifications, and regulatory compliance. These products are exported worldwide to Europe, North and South America, Australia, Japan, and the Middle East, serving importers, distributors, retailers, supermarkets, and e-commerce brands. International Certifications Our ISO9001- and ISO14001-certified facilities support a monthly capacity of approximately 200,000 units. The factory has passed BSCI, Sedex, ISO9001, and ISO14001 audits, and our products comply with CE, GS, ETL, UL, RoHS, and FSC packaging requirements, as well as ErP and environmental regulations. Quality assurance is built into every stage of production through ERP-managed supply chains, 100% inspection, third-party audits by SGS and TUV, and full 6S management. Over 20,000 Square Meters Strong in-house R&D and engineering capabilities enable continuous product improvement, structural optimization, and technology innovation, supported by multiple utility and design patents. The factory covers more than 20,000 square meters and employs over 600 skilled workers, with dedicated QC and engineering teams and 16 automated production lines covering injection molding, assembly, aging tests, and packaging. We ship millions of units annually with export turnover exceeding USD 20 million. OEM and ODM Services Long-term cooperation with global brands and retailers such as Lidl, ACCO, Officeworks, Office Depot, and Staples demonstrates our strength in quality consistency, compliance management, cost control, and large-scale production reliability. Global brands choose JACC for true factory-direct manufacturing with full control over cost, quality, and delivery, proven OEM and ODM experience, competitive mass-market pricing, stable supply for large-volume tenders, and strong plastic injection and structural control. We offer flexible MOQs, fast lead times, private-label customization, global plug and voltage options, and certification support for international markets. Through ongoing participation in major trade shows such as IFA Berlin, the Hong Kong Electronics Fair, and Paperworld Frankfurt, we maintain strong global visibility and buyer confidence. company background: Dongguan Meycun Electronics Technology Co.,Ltd Overseas Manufacturing Base ODM OEM Country/Region: China Business Type: Manufacturer
other details: 17 Years of Industry Expertise Dongguan Meycun Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. is a professional electronics manufacturing service (EMS) provider with 17 years of industry expertise. The company specializes in OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturing) and ODM (Original Design Manufacturing) services, delivering comprehensive solutions from initial product design to final assembly. With a commitment to quality, innovation, and corporate responsibility, Meycun Electronics serves a diverse global clientele, having successfully collaborated with over 300 customers. Manufacturing Prowess and Technical Expertise The company operates a robust manufacturing facility equipped with 6 SMT (Surface Mount Technology) lines and 6 automatic THT (Through-Hole Technology) lines, supported by a skilled workforce of approximately 300 technicians. Its core strength lies in a reliable supply chain, including strategic partnerships with key IC suppliers such as Joulwatt and South Chip, who are also suppliers to major brands like Huawei, Xiaomi, and Samsung. Meycun Electronics further demonstrates its technical capability through a dedicated R&D team of 2 electronics engineers and 2 structural engineers. This team manages the entire development process from mold design and PCBA layout to final assembly, delivering approximately 5 new ODM products annually and handling 2-3 new ODM cases per month, backed by an annual investment of around 3 million RMB in mold development. Stringent Quality Assurance and Compliance Quality control is integral to Meycun's operations, managed by a dedicated team of 30 QC personnel. The company implements a rigorous, multi-stage inspection protocol covering Incoming (IQC), In-Process (IPQC), and Final Quality Control (EQC). The process involves thorough checks of electronic components and structural parts, real-time monitoring of SMT/THT defects, comprehensive performance and safety testing (including high/low voltage, surge protection, and efficiency), and a final full appearance inspection. All finished products undergo an aging process, powered under rated load for 2-4 hours to identify potential failures. This system is supported by advanced equipment, including AOI machines, protection testers, power analyzers, and automated aging lines. The company's quality standards are validated by third-party certifications from TUV and SGS, alongside adherence to BSCI, ISO 9001, and ISO 14001 standards, reflecting its commitment to social responsibility and environmental management. Global Engagement and Future Vision Meycun Electronics actively engages with the global market, regularly participating in major international trade shows such as the HK Global Resources Exhibition. The company maintains a consistent and professional presence, showcasing its capabilities at dedicated booths. Looking forward, Meycun is expanding its footprint with a new 13,000 sqm factory in Shenzhen's Guangming district, scheduled for operation in April 2026. This expansion signifies its growth and enhanced production capacity. The company fosters a responsible corporate culture, emphasizing employee welfare and shared destiny, which translates into high-quality products and reliable service, supported by a remarkably low general defect rate of 0.1-0.3%. For global partners, the company offers flexible trade terms, primarily FOB and EXW.

other details: Professional Thermal Solution Manufacturer Since 2003 Dongguan Mingwang Electronics Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is a professional thermal solution manufacturer with 23 years of expertise, headquartered in Dongguan, the core electronics manufacturing hub in China. We specialize in the R&D and production of CPU coolers, aluminum heat sinks, and customized thermal solutions. Equipped with a full in-house production chain, we provide one-stop service from thermal simulation to mass production, serving global brand owners, distributors, and OEM clients worldwide. Main Product Series We offer CPU and GPU cooling solutions compatible with Intel and AMD platforms, including tower and low-profile ITX designs, as well as cooling products for NVIDIA and AMD graphics cards. We also provide server and industrial cooling modules for data centers and telecommunications infrastructure. Our aluminum heat sink series includes standard extruded profiles for LED and industrial applications, high-performance high-density fin and skiving fin designs, and bonded and folded fin configurations for customized projects. Furthermore, we deliver integrated thermal management systems such as LED thermal modules for street lighting, high-bay, and commercial lighting, liquid cooling plates for electric vehicles, energy storage systems, and high-power industrial applications, copper heat pipe assemblies, and fully customized thermal solutions. In-House Manufacturing Capabilities Our 10,000-square-meter factory is ISO 9001 certified and features end-to-end production lines capable of meeting medium to high-volume order demands. The factory houses 60 sets of high-precision CNC machining centers and aluminum extrusion equipment, a professional thermal simulation and performance testing laboratory, and automated stamping, fin forming, and assembly lines. Our in-house surface treatment workshop provides processes including anodizing, powder coating, and nickel plating. With a stable monthly production capacity of 800,000 units, we maintain flexible scheduling to align with project timelines. Quality Control and Certifications We implement full-process quality management from raw material inspection to finished product delivery. All products comply with international standards, including CE, RoHS, and REACH, and undergo 100% performance testing before shipment to ensure precise thermal resistance, long-term reliability, and stable performance in harsh operating conditions. Full-Cycle Customization Service Our in-house engineering team provides end-to-end customization support, covering thermal simulation, material selection, and structural design, independent mold development and secondary CNC machining, surface treatment, custom logo printing, and exclusive packaging design. Order Specifications and Lead Times Minimum order quantities are 500 pieces for standard products and 1,000 pieces for customized OEM/ODM projects. Sample lead time typically ranges from 3 to 7 days, while mass production lead time is generally 15 to 25 days. We guarantee a response to all inquiries within 24 hours.

other details: Focused on Open-Ear Audio Innovation Dongguan Naiting Acoustic Technology Co., Ltd., established in 2014, is a professional manufacturer dedicated to open-ear headphones and audio solutions. With 11 years of audio expertise and 6 years specializing in open-ear technology, the company has become a trusted OEM/ODM partner for global brands. Its product lines cover air conduction and bone conduction headphones, including IPX5 air conduction sports headphones, IPX5-IPX7 bone conduction sports headphones, IP68 swimming headphones, bone conduction hearing aids, Bluetooth audio glasses, bone conduction helmet headphones, and call center headsets. Strong R&D and Engineering Capability Backed by a team of 17 senior engineers and more than 100 patents, Naiting leads the industry in structural design, acoustic tuning, and applied innovation. From introducing the first air conduction headphones in 2019, to bone conduction hearing aids in 2021, helmet-integrated devices in 2022, and open-ear noise cancellation in 2023, the company continuously proves its ability to tackle high-barrier technical challenges and deliver market-ready solutions. Certified Quality and Global Compliance The company operates under ISO9001, ISO14001, and BSCI certifications, with products conforming to CE, RoHS, and FCC standards, and battery safety requirements including MSDS and UN38.3. Equipped with a strict QC/QA system and over a dozen professional testing devices, Naiting ensures that every shipment meets the highest quality standards, while also assisting clients with local product certification worldwide. Large-Scale Manufacturing Capacity With two factories located in Shenzhen (2,000 sqm) and Dongguan (6,000 sqm), the company employs 200-250 staff and achieves a production capacity of up to 300,000 units per month. Specific models such as IPX5 sports headphones can reach 10,000 pcs per day, while IP68 swimming headphones can reach 2,000-3,000 pcs per day. Typical lead time for customized OEM/ODM projects is 20-25 days, ensuring both large-scale production capability and on-time delivery. Trusted by Global Brands Naiting products are widely recognized in Europe, North America, Southeast Asia, Japan, Korea, and China. The company has cooperated with well-known names such as CCTV, ZDEER, Britz, IRIVER, ATWO, PORTRONICS, RCA, Outdoor Tech, JETE, FUKUMIMI, ELSONIC, and many others under NDA. With experience in brand clients procurement processes, the team is adept at risk control, communication efficiency, and long-term partnership building.

Our products not only support corporate sustainability goals but also help optimize operational costs and improve long-term competitiveness, creating lasting value for our partners. Action-Oriented Approach for a Greener Future Through a practical "green thinking, green action" philosophy, we turn ideals into measurable outcomes. other details: UK-Led International Management Guangzhou Crest Fragrance Technology Co., Ltd. combines a UK-led international business team with Guangzhou-based product development and manufacturing. This structure brings professional cross-border buyer communication together with an efficient fragrance and packaging supply chain. Overseas market requirements and buyer feedback are communicated directly to our development and production teams, reducing misunderstandings, shortening response times and improving project accuracy. Focused on Two Fragrance Categories We specialize in two core product lines: private-label perfumes and reed diffusers. Our perfume solutions cover common capacities from 30ml to 100ml, while our reed diffuser range includes 100ml and 150ml options. By concentrating on these two categories instead of unrelated consumer products, our team can respond more effectively to fragrance performance, packaging, market positioning and region-specific requirements. Six Areas of Customization Our OEM/ODM service covers six key areas: fragrance and scent intensity, formula and concentration, product capacity, bottle and closure components, logo and label decoration, and retail packaging. Available decoration options include screen printing, hot stamping and customized labels. We can also coordinate individual cartons, gift boxes and market-oriented packaging solutions according to each buyer's positioning and budget. Market-Oriented Product Development Our development process begins with the buyer's target market, customer group, retail price and sales channel, not only with a fragrance sample. Our international team translates overseas retail expectations into practical product requirements, while the Guangzhou team evaluates fragrance intensity, diffuser performance, formula compatibility, component matching and packaging feasibility. Entry-level, mid-market and upgraded solutions can be developed for different commercial needs. Eight-Step Project Coordination We provide an eight-step project service covering concept confirmation, fragrance selection, formula evaluation, bottle and closure sourcing, artwork and packaging coordination, sample development, production management and export packing support. Buyers work with one coordinated team from the initial concept through sampling and mass production, making complex private-label projects easier and more efficient to manage. Reliable Production and Long-Term Support For standard projects with approved samples, confirmed artwork and available materials, the typical production lead time is approximately 25-35 days. Our team maintains batch records and carries out filling checks, component inspections and final packaging checks throughout production. We support emerging brands, distributors, retailers, gift companies and hospitality buyers seeking clear English communication, structured quotations and dependable follow-up, from the first test sample to repeat orders.

other details: Two Brands Guangzhou Longjia Automotive Electronics Co., Ltd. specializes in car audio systems and in-vehicle acoustic products, building its international business around two distinctive brands: Rainbow and MusicFire. Rainbow represents precision acoustics, high-performance engineering and complete car audio solutions, while MusicFire brings quality sound to a broader generation of drivers through a younger, more accessible and lifestyle-oriented approach. Different in character yet united by one purpose, the two brands share a simple ambition: to bring better sound to more cars, more markets and more everyday journeys. Engineered in Germany Rainbow is the engineering and acoustic-performance cornerstone of the two-brand portfolio. Officially positioned around Car Audio Engineered in Germany , Rainbow develops its products with a strong focus on acoustic accuracy, material research, sound performance and manufacturing quality. Its international reputation is supported by a documented record in the car audio industry. According to Rainbow's official brand history, its first speaker system received a Red Dot Design Award in 2003 , while the brand has accumulated 43 trophies in car audio competitions across 17 countries . These milestones reflect more than technical achievement - they represent Rainbow's long-standing participation in the global culture of performance car audio. Made for a New Generation MusicFire opens a different path within the portfolio. Rather than replicating Rainbow, it is built around the idea of music freedom - bringing car audio beyond the enthusiast community and into the everyday lives of a younger and more diverse generation of drivers. Its philosophy is straightforward: good sound should be enjoyable, understandable and accessible, supported by products that deliver meaningful improvement without unnecessary complexity. Today, the MusicFire portfolio spans speakers, amplifiers, subwoofers, car cameras, infotainment systems and accessories , with its catalogue carrying the messages German Engineering and Designed by Rainbow . This creates a clear connection between established acoustic know-how and a broader, more approachable car audio experience. From Components to Complete Sound Systems Together, Rainbow and MusicFire create a broad ecosystem for in-car sound - from speakers, midrange drivers, tweeters, amplifiers, DSP and subwoofers to vehicle-specific and complete system solutions. The focus is not simply on individual specifications, but on how every component works together inside the vehicle environment. Rainbow's official portfolio spans core categories including speakers, subwoofers and amplifiers, while MusicFire expands the range across different price points, upgrade stages and customer needs. This dual-brand structure allows us to serve different markets without forcing every customer into the same solution: Rainbow builds depth in performance, MusicFire expands the reach of great sound. A Brand Network Built for the World Rainbow's global reach is part of its brand, not just marketing. Its network spans Germany, China and Hong Kong, with products engineered in Germany for global customers. With MusicFire, we connect distributors, importers, installers and partners worldwide. We build lasting partnerships, not just transactions - on brand value, reliable products, clear positioning and mutual growth. Through two brands, we aim to make Rainbow and MusicFire heard, experienced and trusted in more markets, vehicles and journeys.

other details: About Us We are a premier Chinese manufacturer specializing in portable illumination products. We serve distributors, wholesalers, and OEM clients across over 30 countries. Our expertise spans handheld flashlights, headlamps, LED camping lanterns, solar-charging lights, and tactical searchlights - including advanced LEP (Laser Excited Phosphor) and high-output models exceeding 5,000 lumens. Our Factory & Production Capacity Our 10,000sqm facility in Guangdong Province houses dedicated assembly lines operated by 200 skilled personnel, delivering an annual output of 300,000+ units. The factory integrates incoming material inspection, SMT assembly, mechanical sub-assembly, final assembly, and a specialized quality laboratory under one roof. In-house capabilities include CNC machining, PCB assembly, LED module integration, and final calibration. We support flexible MOQs, private labeling, and custom packaging to meet diverse market requirements. Research & Development Our dedicated R&D team drives continuous innovation across optical design, LED driver electronics, battery management, and thermal engineering. Core competencies include custom reflector and TIR lens design, constant-current drivers with multi-mode UI, USB-C charging platforms, and LEP technology for extreme beam distances. We follow a structured stage-gate development process from concept to pilot production, supporting both branded launches and bespoke ODM projects. Utility model and design patents protect our proprietary innovations. Quality Management & Certifications Our manufacturing is certified to ISO 9001, CE, RoHS, REACH, FCC, and UKCA standards. Quality is governed by a three-tier framework: IQC - Incoming Material Inspection: All components are sampled and tested against approved specifications. LED emitters undergo luminous flux, CCT, and CRI verification using integrating sphere equipment. IPQC - In-Process Quality Control: QC inspectors monitor each production line, testing driver boards, waterproof sealing, switch cycling, and optical alignment in real time. FQC/OQC - Final & Outgoing Quality Control: 100% functional testing; IPX water-resistance sampling, drop testing, and cosmetic inspection per AQL standards before shipment. All quality data is digitally logged. Non-conformance trends trigger root-cause analysis and corrective action plans. Third-party validation is conducted through TUV Rheinland and SGS. Global Markets Approximately 80-90% of total production is exported to over 30 countries. Primary markets include the United States, Australia, Europe, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East. We ship FOB Shenzhen/Guangzhou and support LCL consolidation for cost-efficient smaller orders. A standard warranty of 12-24 months is provided depending on product category, backed by a responsive after-sales support system that includes spare parts supply and technical assistance. Organization & Team Our 200-person workforce is organized into seven departments: Management & Administration, R&D & Engineering (approx. 10), Production & Assembly (approx. 120), Quality Assurance (approx. 15), Procurement & Supply Chain (approx. 10), Sales & Marketing (approx. 20), and Logistics & Warehousing (approx. 10). Production supervisors average over 8 years of industry tenure. We invest in ongoing training on IPC soldering standards, ESD-safe handling, and quality inspection methodologies, and maintain a safe, well-ventilated working environment.

other details: Introduction The company was established in 2014 and is headquartered in Bao'an District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, a significant hub for electronic manufacturing in China. It is a high-tech enterprise that integrates research and development, production, and sales, focusing on the audio equipment sector. Its main products include live-streaming sound cards, microphones, and remote-controlled microphones, and it serves clients across industries such as online streaming, recording, and gaming entertainment. Production Capacity Headquartered in Shenzhen's Fuyong Street Fenghuang First Industrial Zone, our 3,000-square-meter factory houses a complete production line and a dust-free assembly workshop. Annually producing over 300,000 audio cards and related equipment, we demonstrate flexible manufacturing capabilities to quickly respond to customized orders and bulk production demands. R&D Strength Furuijie has an independent technical research and development center, with a team of over 20 engineers covering various fields including audio circuit design, embedded system development, and app support development. The company invests more than 10% of its annual revenue in new product development, having applied for and obtained several patents related to audio technology. Typical products such as the V8S and F998 models are independently developed by the internal team and possess independent intellectual property rights. Quality Certification and Inspection Measures The company places great importance on product quality management and has obtained ISO 9001 quality management system certification. Its flagship products have passed international certifications such as FCC (Federal Communications Commission of the USA) and CE (European Conformity), complying with overseas market entry standards. The production process implements multiple quality control measures, including IQC (Incoming Quality Control), IPQC (In-Process Quality Control), and OQC (Outgoing Quality Control), ensuring that the product qualification rate is above 99% from raw material procurement to final shipment. Export Share Furuijie products are exported to over 30 countries and regions worldwide, particularly gaining a good reputation and stable customer base in Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Europe, and South America. Exports account for over 80% of the company's total sales, making it an active player among Chinese export-oriented audio equipment manufacturers. Product Warranty and After-Sales Service All company products come with a 1-year limited warranty. The after-sales service team supports multilingual responses, covering technical support, remote debugging, repairs, and returns, with a response time not exceeding 24 hours. Industry Participation and Exhibition Experience The company actively participates in industry exchanges and brand promotion, having attended the Hong Kong Global Resources Expo multiple times. Through exhibitions, the company continuously expands its international influence and establishes a stable overseas distribution network. The company is also a member of the Shenzhen Audio and Video Industry Association, engaging in the formulation and promotion of audio product standards. Factory and Personnel Composition The company currently has over 200 employees, with approximately 75% in production, 15% in R&D, and the rest in marketing, quality control, and management. The factory is equipped with automatic surface mount technology machines, audio testing instruments, aging test rooms, and dust-free assembly workshops, ensuring efficient operations from design to delivery.

other details: Premium Bentonite Cat Litter Manufacturer Since 2003 Inner Mongolia Heyuan Bentonite Technology Co., Ltd. was established in 2003, with legal representative Zhang Xuejun. It has been a representative of Ningcheng County People's Congress for two consecutive terms and is a 3.15 integrity commitment unit for national integrity management. The company is located in Donggouqiu Village, Mangnong Town, Ningcheng County, Chifeng City, Inner Mongolia, at the junction of Liaoning, Inner Mongolia, and Hebei provinces. Roads and railways run through the north and south, and can directly connect to Tianjin, Dalian, and Jinzhou ports, making transportation very convenient. Resources & Strong Production Capacity Heyuan Company is a large-scale private enterprise that integrates mining, deep processing, and new product R&D, capitalizing on local high-quality bentonite resources. The company currently holds fixed assets of 80 million yuan and owns high-quality bentonite mines with recoverable reserves exceeding 40 million tons. Our R&D and production portfolio encompasses six main categories: activated clay, precision casting soil, drilling mud soil, feed additives, environmentally friendly bentonite, and pet care products (bentonite cat litter). Annual production capacities include 60,000 tons of activated clay, 100,000 tons of drilling mud, 500,000 tons of pet litter, 20,000 tons of sodium-based bentonite for casting, and 50,000 tons of montmorillonite feed additives, forming a total annual mining and processing capacity exceeding 1 million tons. Certified by ISO 9001:2015 In August 2021, our company obtained ISO 9001:2015 quality management system certification. Equipped with a professional R&D team and an advanced bentonite research laboratory, we maintain strict quality control throughout production. This enables us to consistently deliver high-quality, stable bentonite products to domestic and international markets. Through years of systematic operations, we have established long-term supply relationships with multiple regions and countries worldwide. Technical Advantages On the basis of fully absorbing advanced experience in the production, processing, application, research and development of bentonite at home and abroad, our company has unique features in the formulation of product technical indicators, design of production process flow, and selection of equipment. As a result, our company has been in a leading position with a high starting point, high standards, and high efficiency since its establishment. Core Values & Management Philosophy Since its establishment, the company has adhered to the highest business philosophy of "quality first, customer foremost, and continuous progress." Guided by management principles of "respect, self-respect, unity, and progress," we work alongside our employees toward common advancement. Our commitment encompasses consistent and stable quality requirements, fast and flexible responsiveness, accurate and timely delivery, innovative technology, the pursuit of excellence, fairness and integrity, a civilized and harmonious environment, and perfect, thoughtful service to fully satisfy customer requirements. We actively embrace challenges and continuously improve ourselves to achieve our business goals of enhanced management, quality, efficiency, and scale. Commitment to Partnership The company always adheres to the concept of progress and development together with you, mutual benefit, and win-win cooperation, working hand in hand with you to create "brilliance"!

company background: INTOUCH Hong Kong Limited OEM OBM Country/Region: Hong Kong SAR Business Type: Exporter , Buying Office , Distributor , Other
other details: Brand Overview INTOUCH is a leading accessories brand specializing in electronic accessories and digital devices. By leveraging cutting-edge technology alongside sustainable materials and solutions, we shape the future of electronic accessories for a better world, manufacturing goods for both clients and end users. Product Range and Eco-Design We focus on the development, production, and sales of electronic items, including power banks, wireless chargers, car adapters, wall chargers, charging cables, TWS earphones, and Bluetooth speakers. In recent years, our products have adopted eco-design standards, using recycled plastic and recycled aluminum alloy as core raw materials. We develop and promote eco-friendly products strictly in line with low-carbon development philosophies. Partnerships and Branding Insights Over the past 30 years, we have partnered with numerous top-tier brands across the mobile communications sector. Through these collaborations, we have gained profound insights into core brand-building principles, including consistent core values, refined product positioning, and forward-thinking long-term vision. Identifying an Industry Gap During close cooperation with these renowned partners, we identified an industry shortfall: many mature and reputable brands failed to formulate complete sustainable development roadmaps. Driven to fill this gap, we set out to launch premium, innovative, and reasonably priced products with reduced environmental footprints, which eventually gave birth to INTOUCH. Sustainability Goals and Practical Adjustments Built around future sustainability, the brand targets zero use of plastic and toxic substances to safeguard a cleaner living environment for younger generations. Originally, we planned to roll out a full lineup of eco-friendly products at launch, yet an in-depth feasibility assessment proved this to be economically unworkable in the early stage. We therefore prioritized brand development to lay solid groundwork for our environmental targets. Current Achievements and Future Commitment We are delighted to confirm that all our packaging is now crafted from 100% recycled materials, and we continue advancing the R&D of fully sustainable merchandise. We sincerely appreciate your ongoing trust and support for INTOUCH amid industry uncertainties. Hand in hand, we can deliver tangible positive environmental outcomes.

other details: Company Overview Kaideli Motor (Jieyang) Co., Ltd. specializes in the R&D and sales of high-performance motors, supported by an elite R&D team with over 20 years of motor development experience. Equipped with professional testing instruments and inspection equipment, the company is dedicated to designing and manufacturing brushless motors with integrated drive control, coreless motors, model aircraft motors, high-voltage brushed DC motors, and series-excited motors for household appliances. Known for their high precision, high torque, low noise, and long service life, Kaidelis products are widely used in medical robots, personal care and power tools, smart home appliances, and food processing equipment. Advanced Manufacturing and Capacity Founded in 1990, Kaideli operates a 15,000-square-meter factory in Jieyang with a workforce of over 200 employees, including a 10-person R&D team. After more than 30 years of development, the facility is equipped with advanced automated production lines and an annual production capacity of 20 million motors. Most key components, such as stator and rotor punching parts and deep-drawn iron shells, are manufactured in-house, ensuring high-quality control and supply chain stability. Products are exported worldwide, covering markets in Europe, North America, and Southeast Asia. Quality Compliance and Industry Recognition The company is certified to ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 standards and is a recognized work safety compliance enterprise. Its motors comply with the EU RoHS environmental standards, with select products certified to CCC, UL, GS, and CE requirements. Recognized as a National High-Tech Enterprise, Key Enterprise of Jieyang City, and holder of the Jieyang Enterprise Technology Center title, Kaideli has developed multiple patented products and earned commendations from national, provincial, and municipal authorities, establishing a strong brand reputation in both domestic and international markets. Commitment to Innovation and Cooperation Kaidelis R&D team actively pursues innovation, investing significant resources in developing superior and competitive motor solutions. This commitment enables the company to meet diverse and evolving industry demands, supporting customers in capturing greater market share. Guided by the corporate spirit of Unity, Innovation, Progress, Kaideli aligns its quality control and management with international leading standards. The company has built strategic partnerships worldwide, establishing itself as a competitive and promising manufacturer in the micro motor industry, dedicated to delivering high-quality products and tailored services for a mutually beneficial future.

Based in Thanh Hoa, we support importers, distributors, retailers, hospitality suppliers and private-label brands with product development, manufacturing and export packaging. Wide Product Range Our product range includes cutting boards, chopping boards, carving boards, serving boards, cheese and charcuterie boards, wooden trays and customized wooden home products. We work with acacia, teak, bamboo and acacia-rubberwood combinations, offering more than 100+ reference SKUs alongside custom product development. Integrated Manufacturing and Moisture Control Our approximately 2,000+ sqm manufacturing site covers material preparation, cutting, lamination, CNC machining, sanding, finishing, quality inspection and packing. Reference production capacity is 2,000 pieces per day , with actual output depending on product construction, dimensions, finish and packaging. Two dedicated moisture-control chambers support wood conditioning and moisture management throughout the production process. Together with material inspection and manufacturing controls, they help us prepare products to the agreed specifications. Quality checks cover five stages: incoming materials, manufacturing, surface preparation, finishing and final release . We inspect moisture, dimensions, bonding, surface quality, functional details and packaging against the approved specification and reference sample. Our baseline moisture target is 8 to 12% at packing, unless a different range is agreed for the product. Flexible OEM/ODM and Private Label Solutions Buyers can select existing designs or develop a collection around their own market requirements. Available constructions include edge grain, end grain, herringbone and other decorative patterns, depending on the material and intended use. Customization covers dimensions, thicknesses, shapes, edges, juice grooves, handles and hanging holes. Branding options include laser engraving, heat stamping, labels and branded packaging. We review technical feasibility and confirm the product specification, reference sample and packaging details before production. Packaging options include sleeves, retail boxes, protective wrapping, dividers and inner cartons. Each packing arrangement considers product weight, surface protection, branding and shipment requirements. Your Woodenware Manufacturing Partner in Vietnam Our combination of material choices, custom development, integrated production and defined quality checks helps buyers coordinate product design, manufacturing and packaging with one supplier. Send us your target product, specifications, quantity, destination market and packaging requirements. Our team will review your brief and propose a suitable product configuration, sampling plan and quotation.

other details: Welcome to KIYE PET HEALTH CO., LTD. We are an innovative company dedicated to the health management of middle-aged and senior pets. As pets live longer, age-related challenges such as joint degeneration, fragile digestion, and cognitive decline are becoming increasingly common in older dogs and cats. Yet pets cannot speak, and owners often notice these issues only when they have already progressed. KIYE was founded to break this cycle of "unconscious waiting." From Data Alerts to Actionable Solutions We believe that simply monitoring data creates anxiety without offering real help. That is why KIYE has built a unique closed-loop business model that combines data early warning with precise nutritional intervention. Our self-developed smart vital-sign collar accurately tracks heart rate, body temperature, and activity patterns, while our proprietary algorithms filter out motion noise to detect early health abnormalities in senior pets-long before symptoms become obvious. Nutrition Tailored to Every Stage of Aging When an alert is triggered, we don't just notify-we provide solutions. Our product line includes morning and evening nutritional programs and intensive therapeutic supplements, specifically formulated for aging pets. From daily digestion and coat care to acute joint repair, these targeted nutrition plans help slow the aging process. Our core portfolio consists of: KIYE Smart Vital Sign Monitoring Collar - the digital nerve center for health management. KIYE Senior Pet Nutrition Series - including daily mixed rice with meat floss, morning/evening nutritional packs, and digital prescription treatment packs activated by data alerts. The Future Is Predictive, Not Reactive We see the ultimate goal of pet healthcare as early screening and home-based intervention. KIYE's long-term competitive advantage will not be hardware or formulas alone, but the lifelong vital-sign data from millions of pets. By combining collar-collected metrics heart rate variability (HRV), micro-fluctuations in temperature, gait characteristics, and clinical pathology data we are training our proprietary AI-assisted diagnostic model. This enables a shift from simple "abnormal warnings" to disease probability predictions, for example: "85% probability of an arthritis flare-up within the next 3 days." Our Vision and Values KIYE PET HEALTH CO., LTD. is more than a manufacturer of hardware or health products. Our vision is to become the most trusted health steward for senior pets. We strive to deliver an integrated service spanning hardware, software, and nutrition so that every aging pet can live with greater dignity and enjoy more quality time alongside their loving owners. Let us Shape the Future Together We look forward to partnering with you to create a new era in pet health one where prevention, precision, and compassion come together to make every year count.

other details: Since 2002 Founded in 2002 and headquartered in Ningbo, China, Loctek Ergonomics Technology Co., Ltd. is a National Single Champion Demonstration Enterprise that integrates smart-home and overseas public-warehouse operations. Listed on the ChiNext Board of the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2017, it is the first listed company in the health ergonomics sector and the first cross-border e-commerce enterprise in China to go public via IPO. Manufacturing Scale & R&D Strength With four global manufacturing bases, over 4,000 employees, and business coverage across 115 countries and regions, Loctek operates three high-tech enterprises and maintains a professional R&D team of more than 1,000 members. The team focuses on core fields such as mechatronics, embedded software and hardware, IoT, 5G technology applications, and high-speed low-noise linear drive technologies. Multiple core technologies have broken longstanding foreign monopolies. R&D Investment & Achievements In collaboration with industrial chain partners and leading domestic universities, the company has established the industry's first Smart Health Research Institute. With cumulative R&D investment exceeding RMB 480 million over the past three years, Loctek holds a series of national-level qualifications, including the National Enterprise Technology Center, National Industrial Design Center, and National Postdoctoral Research Workstation. It has obtained 1,281 global patents, 190 of which are invention patents, and is recognized as a National Intellectual Property Demonstration Enterprise. Financial Performance In 2024, Loctek achieved operating revenue of RMB 5.67 billion, a year-on-year increase of 45.33%. Revenue from overseas warehouse services reached RMB 2.423 billion, up 154.76% year-on-year, while cross-border e-commerce revenue hit RMB 2.026 billion, rising 14.28% year-on-year. In the first three quarters of 2025, the company's total revenue reached RMB 4.846 billion, growing 29.56% year-on-year. Overseas warehouse service revenue stood at RMB 2.348 billion, up 46.2% year-on-year, demonstrating strong and sustained growth momentum.

other details: Industry-leading Solution Provider MoYoung was established in 2015 and is headquartered in Taihua Wutong Industrial Park, Taihua, Baoan District, Shenzhen. MoYoung has been committed to providing customers with professional smart wearable device integrated solutions and is now almost the world's biggest solution company. The founders of MoYoung are all from mature internet enterprises, with internet thinking that regards user experience to great importance. With the enthusiasm and perseverance of several young engineers in ten years, MoYoung's team has gone through an arduous pioneering period to become a mature solution provider with a leading position in the industry today. We provide all-in-one solutions for smart wearable devices and a high-quality and outstanding user experience. Professional Teams of More than 100 People MoYoung has been in the field of smart wearables for many years. We currently have a mature and comprehensive software design team, research and development team, testing team, hardware design team, production team, and customer service team - totaling more than 100 people. MoYoung’s teams prioritize customers, and there have been many cases of customizing smart wearable solutions for long-term customer value. An elite team with a serious and responsible attitude is dedicated to providing excellent customized solutions for our customers. In recent years, MoYoung has been expanding its team size and improving its ability, always striving to build a first-class team with strong ability and single-mindedness for the people. Research and Development MoYoung's R&D team currently includes a hardware research and development team, embedded research and development team, app research and development team, back-office data research and development team, software test team, and hardware test team - totaling more than 40 people. Team members have many years of experience in smart wearables and health research and development. They are committed to smart wearable health data and motion data algorithm research, user experience research, multi-platform fit research, hardware system optimization, stability optimization research, and other research directions.MoYoung provides excellent products with an experienced and skilled R&D team to serve our customers. Design MoYoung has a strong team of designers who were already excellent front-end (iOS, Android, Web, desktop) designers in the Internet industry before entering the smart wear field. Several designers have become professional designers in the former mobile internet era, and have a deep understanding of the underlying implementation logic of design, so they can achieve better visual performance in non-platform embedded research and development. The MoYoung team has the ultimate pursuit of visual presentation and user experience, with precise to pixel-level requirements for visual expression, based on user data and optimizing their experience with interactive design. We have a group of designers who focus on design, drawing every icon and page with precision and creating every transition and illustration dynamic. These people are the carriers of the creative spirit of MoYoung.

(KETRON) is a China-based high-tech enterprise with over 20 years of experience in the R&D, manufacturing, and sales of smart wearable products. Located in Zhejiang Province, the company operates an industrial park of more than 30,000 square meters and specializes in smart watches and connected safety and health monitoring solutions. Connected Wearable Project Experience KETRON focuses on smart watches for safety and wellness scenarios. The team supports older adults living alone, lone and field workers, and institutional programs with connected hardware, monitoring and alert workflows, device management, platform testing and integration support. Our technical materials can include API interface specifications, interface descriptions, SDK examples, communication protocol documents, server deployment plans, testing tools and access guidance according to project scope. Development and Recognition The wider corporate group traces its development to 1990, while the smart-watch business began in 2018. Ningbo Keqiang Battery Co., Ltd. was included in the 2018 second-batch Smart Health and Elderly Care Application Pilot Demonstration list. KETRON-related smart-watch models were included in the 2018, 2020, 2022, and 2024 Smart Health and Elderly Care Product and Service Promotion Catalogs. The applicable legal entity, model, and scope are defined by the official documents. Product Features and Applications Our products are mainly designed for elderly care, personal safety, lone worker protection, health monitoring, and institutional applications. Depending on the model, our solutions support GPS/Wi-Fi/LBS positioning, SOS alerts, two-way communication, fall detection, heart rate and other health monitoring functions, sleep monitoring, geofencing, and remote device management. OEM/ODM Services KETRON provides complete OEM/ODM services, covering product design, hardware and RF development, firmware and software development, prototype testing, data integration, packaging customization, and mass production. We have integrated with over 500 customer platforms and completed more than 100 in-depth customization projects, enabling us to support customers with diverse product and system requirements. Product Recognition and Patents Our products are recognized for their reliability and practical applications. Popular models, including H002, H002C, H003, and H003C, have been granted 12 patents. These products were developed to help families stay connected with and better care for elderly parents through smart wearable technology. Served More than 3,000 Customers Over the years, KETRON has served more than 3,000 customers, including telecare providers, monitoring centers, healthcare and senior living organizations, system integrators, telecommunications operators, public-sector projects, and other industry partners. Production Capacity and Support Our production facilities have a stated monthly capacity of more than 300,000 units. We also provide product testing, technical integration, training, delivery, and after-sales support to help customers bring complete wearable safety and health solutions to market. Brand and Global Cooperation KETRON is a well-known brand in Zhejiang Province, recognized for its innovation and contribution to the local economy. We welcome partners worldwide to work with us on new products, customized solutions, and long-term business cooperation.

company background: Primustron Electronics (Beijing) ODM OEM OBM Country/Region: China Business Type: Manufacturer
other details: Two Decades of High-End Manufacturing Excellence Founded in 2000, Primustron Electronics is a premier EMS provider. For 24+ years, we have delivered high-reliability production solutions designed for diverse and complex client needs. We bridge the gap between engineering concepts and physical products with uncompromising efficiency and technical depth. Scalable Infrastructure and Precision Environment To support global industrial demands, Primustron operates multiple production bases in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region. Our total facility area spans 28,000 sqm, including a 10,000 sqm certified Class 10,000 cleanroom. This ensures an ultra-clean environment for sensitive medical and automotive electronics. We also maintain dedicated RoHS workshops and specialized lines for small-batch pilot production, providing agility for both startups and Fortune 500 enterprises. World-Class Hardware and High-Speed Production Equipped with international-standard hardware, we operate 15 high-speed SMT lines powered by YAMAHA mounters and ERSA nitrogen reflow ovens. We achieve placement speeds up to 236,000 CPH per line. To ensure zero-defect quality, we utilize advanced inspection systems, including 3D In-line SPI, 3D AOI, and high-resolution X-ray for complex BGA and fine-pitch verification. Our hardware strength ensures absolute stability for the most intricate multilayer designs. Proprietary Digital Management and Full Traceability Primustron is a leader in digital manufacturing. We utilize a proprietary data management platform integrating custom MES and ERP systems. This allows full-chain, dynamic digital management of the entire production lifecycle. For our partners, this ensures 100% component and process traceability, real-time visibility via data dashboards, and optimized resource allocation. This digital backbone enhances the transparency required in high-stakes sectors such as healthcare and automotive. Comprehensive Engineering and Custom Tooling We stand out through profound engineering capabilities. Our experienced FCT (Functional Circuit Test) team is proficient in developing proprietary test fixtures. To date, we have created over 3,000 custom fixtures for PCBA and full Box Build systems, ensuring 100% compliance with electrical performance standards. Our support begins at the NPI stage, providing expert DFX (DFM, DFA, DFT) reviews and BOM optimization to help clients reduce costs and improve manufacturing yields. Notable Projects and Industry Contributions Primustron's expertise is validated by its contribution to critical projects. We were a pivotal supplier for Huoshenshan and Leishenshan Hospitals, delivering core control boards for ventilators and X-ray machines. In the automotive sector, we serve as a trusted partner to leaders such as Foton Motor. Our footprint also extends to national infrastructure, providing systems for the Beijing, Shenyang, and Chongqing Subways, as well as high-speed EMU trains. Global Quality Compliance A world-class certification framework reinforces our commitment to quality: ISO 13485:2016 (Medical Devices) IATF 16949:2016 (Automotive) ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management) ISO 14001:2015 (Environmental Management) ISO 45001:2018 (Occupational Health & Safety) IECQ QC 080000:2017 (Hazardous Substance Process Management) By integrating these rigorous standards, Primustron provides a stable, compliant, and professional supply chain for global innovators seeking one-stop EMS excellence.

Complete & Customizable Product Portfolio We focus on R&D and mass production of multi-specification PE plastic packaging bags, covering dozens of mature product lines. Our core products include HPPE/LDPE roll t-shirt bags, striped vest bags, flat-roll garbage bags, star-sealed bin liners, printed freezer bags, drawstring refuse sacks, zipper pouches, calendar carry bags, patch-handle shopping bags, and other customized plastic packaging. Since its birth, CONWOOD has exerted a fascination on those fashion pursuers by virtue of its unique charm and "BEST OF THE BEST" philosophy. 30,000sqm Luggage Factory Completed and operational in 2022, the new state-of-the-art CONWOOD factory is easily reached by car from Shanghai and strategically located for accessibility and efficient connection to the company's network of leading material and component suppliers. Since its foundation, products have been exported to Europe, America, Southeast Asia, Dubai, Japan, South Korea, Hong Kong, and more than 50 countries and regions, establishing a strong international sales network and marketing all over the world. So we are updated about the newest market trends globally and are able to create a unique product design. We have gained more than 120 patents and trademarks. To achieve this international standard of quality and ensure that we spot any defects and issues before we ship out our products, we implement a 6-step quality and safety check that sees our products through handling testing (strength of our retractable handles), multiple drop tests (for durability), running tests (for wheels and moving parts), impact tests (for structural stability), temperature tests (in numerous environments) and of course tumble testing (for protection and bag integrity). Our strict quality management system makes sure each bag that leaves any of our factories, should be of high quality and durability. Social Responsibility Conwood has always been committed to the development of public service activities, with the courage to take on the social responsibility of environmental protection, education, disaster relief, and other areas of particular concern.

other details: JetHome - Automation Hardware JetHome develops automation hardware. Our lineup includes Linux and ESP32 controllers for DIN-rail and desktop mounting, Zigbee devices, USB coordinators, single/three-phase power meters, PoE switches and USB-DALI interfaces. Featuring galvanically isolated RS-485 and digital inputs, our hardware also offers KNX, multi-port RS-485 and pluggable expansion modules. Built on open ecosystems such as Home Assistant, ESPHome, Modbus, KNX, DALI, Armbian Linux and PlatformIO/Arduino, there is no vendor lock-in. All hardware, firmware and software are developed in-house. Our products hold RoHS certification verified by an accredited lab, and we are a Connectivity Standards Alliance (CSA) Matter member. TVIP VMS - AI-Powered Next-Gen Video Surveillance TVIP VMS is a video management and analytics platform. It quickly pinpoints key 30-second clips from hours of recordings instead of manual playback scrubbing. Its AI functions include person/vehicle/animal tracking, license plate recognition, heatmaps, zone search, video synopsis, bookmarks and incident files. The built-in AI assistant accepts natural language queries; you can choose cloud or fully on-premise deployment so data stays local. AI models can be switched in settings without system updates. Deployment options include Linux/Windows/macOS servers with NVIDIA GPU load balancing, standalone NPU recorders that support recording, analysis and HDMI video walls without servers, and scalable recorder clusters with no single point of failure. It supports continuous/scheduled/event recording, storage on local disks, NFS/SMB or S3, plus MP4/MPEG-TS export. TVIP - IPTV/OTT Set-Top Boxes TVIP has supplied IPTV and OTT operators since 2013. Our current boxes run Android 11 on Amlogic S905Y4 quad-core 2GHz chips, supporting 4K, AV1, 10-bit HEVC and VP9 decoding. They feature Widevine L1 DRM, HTML5 operator portals, HDMI2.1, USB, MicroSD and AV ports, with Ethernet or dual-band Wi-Fi/Bluetooth variants available on the same platform. TVIP TMS delivers centralized fleet management for operators. We provide long-term firmware and technical support even for 5+ year-old models. The boxes are CE certified, complying with the Radio Equipment, EMC and Low Voltage Directives.

Sinocastel hardware and solutions have been widely used in fleet management, auto insurance UBI, telecommunications industry, car rental business, and home care services.
