Sinocastel entered the IoT market in 2008, focusing on the design, research, and development of IoT big data terminals. It has big data processing and management capabilities for car companies and has conducted extensive and in-depth research with new energy electronic vehicle manufacturers' cooperation. Certified with ISO 9001:2008, CCC, EMARK, ANATEL, etc. Sinocastel has a diverse product line. The main hardware products include OBD trackers, GPS/Beidou trackers for various vehicles, wired GPS trackers, asset GPS trackers, T-BOX, etc, Our products cover multiple technologies based on Bluetooth, GSM, CDMA, WCDMA, LTE, etc., and have passed ISO 9001:2008, CCC, EMARK, ANATEL, AT&T, CE, FCC, PTCRB, JATE, TELEC, and other certifications. Backed by 2 R&D Centers Sinocastel has two R&D centers in Hong Kong and Shenzhen, more than 70% of engineers have a master's degree, and the core personnel are all senior engineers in the industry. The R&D team continues to break through the core technology, forming a comprehensive and reasonable layout of product planning, technology R&D, testing and application, and technical support. The management team has more than 10 years of experience in automotive electronics research and development, internet of vehicle solution design, and operation services, and has accumulated rich experience in automotive bus technology, wireless communication technology, and GPS position technology.

other details: Specializing in Home Textiles Since 2016 Having specialized in cross-border trade circulation and supply chain integration within the home textiles and home furnishing sectors since 2016, we connect high-quality Chinese manufacturing with global consumer demand through diversified international channels such as Amazon, eBay, and Shopify, serving markets across North America, Europe, South America, and beyond. Data-Driven Product Curation We leverage a decade of cross-border e-commerce data accumulated since 2016 to drive our product selection process. By monitoring real-time search trends on platforms like Amazon and eBay, analyzing competitive intensity, and issuing dynamic gross margin alerts based on logistics and raw material costs, we move beyond guesswork. This data-centric approach ensures we identify high-potential products with precision, offering buyers a curated portfolio of items that are not only market-responsive but also optimized for profitability, minimizing risk and maximizing return on investment. Agile Supply Chain Integration with Proprietary Technology Our proprietary platforms, "Lingji Manufacturing" (MES) and a cross-border ERP, digitally connect us with top factories, enabling real-time collaboration from design to quality inspection. This yields a responsive system for both small-batch fast-turnaround and mass production, ensuring flexibility and efficiency. Buyers enjoy reduced lead times, quick adaptation to market changes, and rigorous quality control via digital monitoring. Global Warehousing and Fulfillment Network With strategically located warehouses on the U.S. West and East Coasts, we ensure deep coverage across North American markets. Our fulfillment process, from domestic consolidation and international shipping to customs clearance, storage, and last-mile delivery, achieves a seamless 15-to-25-day end-to-end turnaround. Handling over 140,000 units monthly, our efficient logistics network guarantees timely deliveries, allowing buyers to scale operations confidently without worrying about supply chain bottlenecks. Specialized Expertise in Home Textiles and Hardware We bring deep industry knowledge to home textiles and hardware, offering products that blend design aesthetics with practical functionality. Our textile range features over 50 premium fabrics, from linen and chenille to high-count cotton, with high drape, eco-friendly dyes, and styles suited for residential, hospitality, and office spaces. In hardware, we provide durable, corrosion-resistant components like curtain rods and silent glides, certified to international standards (ISO 9001, SGS). This specialization ensures buyers receive products that meet diverse global preferences with consistent quality. Comprehensive Customization Services Through our flexible supply chain, we offer end-to-end customization for B2B and B2C clients, including bespoke sizing, materials, patterns, and packaging. Our process--from needs assessment and design to rapid prototyping and batch production--enables brands to create unique product lines that stand out in crowded markets. Whether it's tailored curtains or exclusive hardware finishes, we empower buyers to differentiate their offerings and capture niche consumer segments. Robust Quality Assurance and International Compliance We adhere to stringent quality control protocols, with raw material inspections, in-line random checks, and final product inspections for every order. Our commitment to excellence is backed by ISO 9001 certification, regular SGS testing for sustainability and durability, and full compliance with North American and European market regulations.

other details: Company Introduction & Core Mission Founded in 2013, TUGE Technologies is a global leader in the AI-powered Internet of Things (AIoT) platform sector. The company is dedicated to providing a one-stop solution for global network aggregation and connectivity. TUGE empowers enterprise customers across diverse IoT scenarios with intelligent connectivity and operational management services characterized by high performance, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness. Flagship Platform & Seamless Integration The cornerstone of TUGE's offering is its global cloud communication platform. Intelligent devices integrated with TUGE's embedded cloud communication SDK can access this platform with a single click. This enables rapid, one-stop global network interconnection, allowing products to dynamically utilize the best local communication networks on demand. This capability ensures swift and reliable deployment for products entering markets worldwide. Driving Growth Through Independent R&D TUGE's decade of rapid growth is fueled by robust independent research and development. The company's cloud platform has forged partnerships with over 300 mobile operators globally, achieving network coverage in more than 200 countries and regions. Its diverse communication technology solutions serve enterprise customers and channel partners in more than 50 countries and regions. These solutions span key sectors including robotics, smart vehicles, industrial IoT, new energy, smart retail, IP cameras, and cross-border business travel, with both platform capacity and connection volume experiencing rapid growth. Industry Leadership & Recognized Innovation Through continuous innovation and breakthroughs in core technologies, TUGE has established itself as an AIoT industry leader. This is evidenced by its selection as one of "China's Top 100 AIoT Enterprises" for three consecutive years and the receipt of over 20 government honors, including recognition as a National High-Tech Enterprise and a Specialized, Sophisticated SME. TUGE holds more than 50 intellectual property rights across China, the U.S., Japan, and Europe, utilizing patent fast-track systems. Supported by R&D centers in Shanghai, Hefei, and Shenzhen, its products and services enjoy wide recognition from a global customer base. Future Vision: Ubiquitous Connectivity Looking ahead, TUGE Technologies remains focused on creating superior customer value. The company will continue to deepen its expertise in three strategic fields: "intelligent manufacturing overseas," "local mobile IoT," and "cross-border connectivity services." Guided by the vision of ubiquitous connectivity, TUGE is committed to powering a more interconnected and intelligent global future.

other details: Robust Support and Strategic Stability Backed by State-Owned Assets Xuzhou Fengtou Import & Export Trading Co., Ltd. is a wholly owned subsidiary of Feng County Industrial Development & Construction Holding Group, established in July 2025 with a registered capital of RMB 10 million. Strategically Located in China's Electric Tricycle Capital Headquartered in Feng County, renowned as the "Capital of Chinese Electric Tricycles", the company specializes in the export of electric tricycles and is building an integrated, end-to-end service system covering product development, quality control, logistics, and after-sales support. We are also actively expanding trade in complementary product categories. Daily Production Capacity Exceeding 1,000 Vehicles Xuzhou Fengtou operates with an optimized management model and advanced production equipment. Its invested industrial parks span over 150,000 square meters and employ thousands of workers, supporting a daily production capacity of more than 1,000 units. Our capabilities accommodate mass production, OEM, ODM, and custom orders. Specifications, including dimensions, seating, tires, power systems, and control systems, can be tailored to customer requirements, meeting diverse application scenarios. A comprehensive quality control system ensures strict inspection and testing across three critical stages: raw material procurement, production processes, and finished product inspection, guaranteeing that every vehicle meets rigorous quality standards. Wide Product Range and Applications Fengtou offers a complete product portfolio dedicated to providing advanced electric vehicles and design solutions for personal, commercial, and specialty use. Our product lines include cargo and passenger electric tricycles, recreational trikes, and specialized vehicles such as electric sweepers, scrubbers, insulated trucks, irrigation vehicles, and patrol vehicles, which have been widely welcomed by customers across various industries worldwide. Benefit from Us Now Since 2010, products from our industrial parks have been exported to dozens of countries. Supported by professional R&D, full-process quality control, and comprehensive pre- and post-sales services, we have deeply cultivated markets in South America, the Middle East, and Africa. Our team is composed of highly educated engineers and designers, experienced R&D professionals from the electric vehicle industry, and a dedicated sales and export service staff. This professional team provides essential support and around-the-clock after-sales service to ensure all customer needs are met promptly and effectively.
